The background bunks contain thin gray blankets and neatly paired slippers. Frame a three-person medium-wide photograph from just above table height, with the central face and the complete towel-to-stamp contact large enough to inspect together. Soft morning window light crosses the face and white terry cloth, while flat ceiling light leaves the institutional room readable. Muted olive and gray make the small red approval mark the only strong color accent; retain natural skin texture and the palpable weight of fabric in her palms.
